summary: Configured, enabled, and started both inventory programs as systemd services. The API requires the database, starts after its readiness gate succeeds, and both services recovered automatically after node1 rebooted.
actions_performed: Created inventory-database.service with an explicit readiness-marker wait and restart policy.
Created inventory-api.service with Requires/After dependencies and a readiness pre-check.
Enabled both services and verified a clean dependency-driven startup from an absent readiness marker.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified changed boot identity, service recovery, readiness, ordering, and no failed units.

evidence.requirement: Both inventory programs are managed, enabled, and active as systemd services
evidence.summary: Both units are enabled and running with live systemd-managed processes, including after reboot.

evidence.requirement: The API starts only after the database is ready
evidence.summary: The API has resolved Requires/After dependencies and a marker pre-check. A clean start began with no marker, activated the database first, then the API; both readiness gates exited successfully after reboot.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID 54089086-53d1-408b-a22f-57b1dea70e03, received native reboot acknowledgement, observed new boot ID 6888eaf1-84ef-4016-bcae-287257b45add, and confirmed both enabled services, processes, readiness marker, ordering, and system health recovered.
